name: paint
title_zh: 会先跟你吵三版视觉方向才动手的画布
tagline_zh: 受够AI千篇一律的插画风？从艺术方向脑暴到设计系统落地，它先跟你对齐审美，再逐像素实现，最后审计防AI味。
tagline_en: Tired of AI-slop visuals? It brainstorms art direction, builds a design system, implements, and audits—so your UI.
desc_en: Paint a complete visual universe with genjutsu - art direction brainstorm, design system, implementation, audit. Anti-AI-slop design pipeline. Adapts to Web, Android (Compose), Apple (SwiftUI).
why_zh: 不是生成器，是设计流程本身：先吵方向、再定系统、后实现、终审计，四步闭环，把AI味掐死在源头。
why_en: It's a full design pipeline, not a one-shot generator: direction, system, build, audit—each step checks the last, killing the.
limit_zh: 只产出视觉设计资产（配色、字体、组件规范），不生成可运行代码；需要你提供明确的产品上下文或草图，否则它只会空谈风格。
limit_en: Outputs design specs only (colors, type, components), no runnable code. Needs your product context or sketches; otherwise it just philosophizes.
title_en: A canvas that argues art direction with you before painting
